statement: HR-V0 shall be a fixed bench-mounted mechanism with exactly two arm rotation axes and one gripper axis.
HR-V0 shall transfer one soft foam object of no more than 100 g and 70 mm maximum dimension.
Maximum shoulder-to-object reach shall not exceed 360 mm.

Automatic tool-center speed shall not exceed 0.15 m/s. The controller shall derive pose-dependent joint-rate limits from the commanded kinematics; the 30 deg/s joint cap is an additional ceiling and shall never be treated as sufficient enforcement of the tool-center limit.
Setup motion shall be hold-to-run and shall not exceed 10 deg/s.
The system shall operate indoors from 18 to 28 deg C in dry noncondensing conditions.
A dual-channel emergency stop shall remove actuator power without relying on software.
Releasing or resetting the emergency stop shall not initiate motion.

Any control-loss stop credited with reducing risk shall have a qualified ISO 12100 risk determination and a separately validated ISO 13849-1:2023 or IEC 62061 integrity allocation. The ordinary HR-V0 heartbeat controller relays drivers firmware and bus watchdog shall receive no safety credit; HR-30 and any HR-V0 configuration whose fixed guard cannot contain assumed watchdog failure shall select and validate a safety-rated control-loss architecture before motion release.
Fixed shielding and a controlled 600 mm exclusion boundary shall be present for powered V0 fixture tests.
No child shall enter the V0 test area while any actuator can be energized.
Primary mechanical load paths shall survive 3 times maximum permitted operational static load without hazardous failure.
Each joint shall have independent software limits and mechanical hard stops before cable or shield contact.

Any restart after a safety or diagnostic dropout shall require cause removal a valid monitored physical RESET and a later distinct physical ARM action; neither action shall command torque or motion and a fresh validated trajectory shall still be required.
Actuator power, safety-control power, and compute power shall be separately protected domains.
Two series contactors with monitored auxiliary feedback shall interrupt the actuator rail.
Every actuator power branch shall be individually fused and use conductors and connectors rated for the verified load.
Exposed mains terminals shall be inaccessible without a tool and conductive enclosures and structure shall be protectively earthed.
Only deterministic versioned trajectories whose preconditions match the current configuration may command motion.
AI or language-model output shall never write actuator commands or registers directly.
Communication loss, limit violation, overtemperature, or overcurrent shall cause a latched defined fault response.
Command and feedback state shall be logged at 100 Hz or faster with a configuration hash.

During the validated duty cycle arm actuator cases shall remain below the provisional 65 deg C limit, gripper actuator cases below 60 deg C, and power conductors below 20 deg C rise at the released ambient condition.
Grip force shall be characterized across the allowed object range using a calibrated load cell.

The HR-V0 gripper shall use the controlled ROBOTIS OpenMANIPULATOR-X mechanism subset with broad compliant object-contact pads and a fixed local guard that prevents access to the actuator-frame crank linkage and rail pinch zones; no human handoff is permitted.

Before any actuator connection HR-V0 shall have a fixed tool-removable enclosure whose inner boundary remains outside the union of the released three-dimensional swept volume worst-case stopping travel maximum payload extent and build/calibration tolerance by the released minimum clearance in every permitted pose and fault case.
A fixed receiver or catch shall contain the permitted 100 g foam object after commanded release gripper fault or actuator-power loss from every released pose without escape into an accessible area.

Every HR-V0 moving cable and connector shall have a controlled route strain relief service loop bend/twist limit abrasion protection and retention that remains clear of hard stops pinch points guards and payloads throughout the complete mechanical range.
The system shall complete 100 fixture handoffs with at least 99 successes and zero unsafe faults.
Every test record shall identify CAD, wiring, firmware, calibration, actuator, and BOM revisions.
HR-30 neutral-pose overall height shall be 762 mm nominal and remain between 740 and 800 mm for any released shell configuration.
HR-30 tethered mass shall target 8.0 kg and shall never exceed 10.0 kg.
HR-30A shall provide 13 active upper-body degrees of freedom on a bolted pelvic pedestal.
HR-30B full-height testing shall use an engineered restraint that prevents floor impact.
The full-height robot shall remain restrained through HR-30D and shall operate untethered only after the HR-30W release gate is approved.
External covers shall use a 3 mm minimum edge radius and prevent normal access to powered pinch points.
The external form shall be stylized and clearly robotic rather than a realistic imitation child.
HR-30A shall use tethered extra-low-voltage actuator power and shall not carry a battery.
Actuator power state and faults shall be visibly distinguishable from at least 3 m.
Camera recording capability shall have a hardware-driven visible privacy indication.
No powered leg joint shall be enabled until its actuator and structure pass separate load thermal brake and restraint tests.
Untethered level-floor walking shall be the required HR-30W end-state and shall occur only after HR-30D slack-tether acceptance passes.
HR-30W shall stand untethered for 120 seconds on the validated level indoor surface.
HR-30W shall start, walk 25 m at 0.10 to 0.14 m/s, stop within two steps, and remain standing. Any higher speed requires a later released torque-speed and gait validation.
HR-30W shall turn 90 degrees left and right within five steps without support.
HR-30W shall complete 30 minutes cumulative walking without exceeding released thermal current voltage or energy limits.
HR-30D shall walk with a slack overhead tether carrying less than 2 percent of robot weight except during fall arrest.
Each leg shall provide six active axes: hip yaw roll and pitch knee pitch and ankle pitch and roll.
Pelvis attitude estimation shall update at 800 Hz or faster and foot force/center-of-pressure estimation at 500 Hz or faster.
The real-time state estimator and stabilizer shall continue safe operation or stop after failure of the Linux high-level process.
HR-30W shall use an onboard professionally assembled protected battery with pack-level fuse service disconnect precharge and independent telemetry.
Passing the engineering walking test shall not authorize operation among people or children.

A fall predictor shall command the released protective response from attitude, angular rate, support force, joint tracking, bus health, and supply state within a released lead-time threshold derived from measured protective-response latency plus margin. The numeric lead time, detection rate, and false-positive limit are release-blocking selections.
A hardware emergency stop shall remove hazardous drive energy even when doing so may cause a fall.
During HR-30C acceptance both feet shall support 100 percent of measured static robot weight for 120 seconds while the connected restraint supplies no sustained support.
HR-30C shall complete 100 commanded bilateral weight shifts with both feet in contact and without exceeding released force attitude joint-tracking thermal current or deadline limits.
Loss of planner state sensor validity control deadline or supply health during HR-30C shall produce the released restrained response and a latched restart-required fault.
HR-30C powered-stance testing shall not begin until HR-30B W0 W1 restraint proof sensor calibration and enabled-axis qualification records are approved.
The released operating boundary shall state adult-operated experimental robotic machinery not a toy and not approved for unsupervised consumer use while legal classification remains unresolved.

Every full-body configuration shall have a controlled part-level mass and inertia ledger separating target estimate and measured values and reporting assembly and whole-body center of mass and inertia.

HR-V0 moving assembly mass excluding the fixed shoulder actuator and base shall not exceed 0.75 kg and shall be supported by a part-level ledger separating CAD supplier and measured mass local center of mass and inertia for the exact configuration.

Every inter-controller message shall carry a monotonic sequence number source timestamp validity deadline sender state and configuration hash and receivers shall reject stale duplicate out-of-order or mismatched messages.
Every externally reduced leg joint shall use output-side absolute position sensing or a reviewed equivalent that detects slip backlash lost calibration and motor-output disagreement.
Each segmented joint bus shall demonstrate the released command and feedback schedule with a byte-level packet budget measured worst-case latency jitter utilization and injected fault traffic.
Every powered full-body phase shall define and test the response to sudden drive-energy loss for every released pose and mode before restraint dependence is reduced.
A configuration calibration polarity or mirrored-joint mismatch shall inhibit drive enable and latch a recorded fault.
Every requirement risk and release gate shall identify an accountable owner acceptance evidence approver and controlled change history before design review approval.

Before any actuator torque-enable request the supervisor shall verify the received actuator identity firmware ID operating mode startup-torque and torque-on-goal-update bits current limit goal-current bound hardware-error state and torque-off state against the released configuration; any mismatch shall inhibit torque and latch a recorded fault. The internal current limit shall not substitute for external branch-current connector thermal and protection evidence.

For guarded HR-V0 testing the ordinary heartbeat watchdog shall be treated only as an uncredited diagnostic power-removal demand: candidate detection is 300 ms maximum before relay and contactor delays; restoration shall not bypass monitored physical RESET and later physical ARM; the safety risk assessment shall assume that this diagnostic can fail to operate.

The HR-V0 release BOM shall enumerate every purchased fabricated included-kit harness software-image and configuration-critical item with exact quantity order-code state primary-source state application-evidence state and receiving or closure route; every unresolved field shall remain SELECTION REQUIRED.

The HR-V0 mechanical release shall define one controlled bench-to-object datum chain every assembly component every mechanical interface exact profile cut lengths and the closure evidence for each unresolved dimension fastener fit guard stop cable and anchor boundary; generated assembly views shall agree with the native CAD and system BOM.

Every HR-V0 T-slot frame joint shall have an enumerated bracket and mounting-hardware order code quantity orientation load-path screen controlled torque-development method receiving record proof record inspection mark reuse rule and qualified mechanical disposition; absent physical evidence shall inhibit assembly acceptance.

The HR-V0 bench interface shall be released only for one identified surveyed bench with documented owner permission substrate construction thickness edge distances top and underside access exact anchors bolts washers and backing parts calculated shear tension overturning bearing pull-through and bench-support loads controlled installation torque numerical proof criteria inspection marks and qualified mechanical disposition; absent or changed site evidence shall inhibit assembly and energization acceptance.

The HR-V0 arm architecture shall use exact manufacturer-coordinate actuator and frame geometry to define every body-frame output-frame link and gripper transform; the released native assembly shall prove J1/J2 axis orientation and parallelism link lengths collision and tool access fastener stacks cable space structural load path and tolerance closure; any superseded or unresolved transform shall inhibit quotation fabrication assembly and energization.
